_note: settings_iris transition art (Lib/SettingsIris), in 1920x1080 pixels, around the screen's centre. Texture sizes are in the textures' own pixels.

ring._note: radius: the radius of Ring.png's line (1024 px image); a circle smaller than fade_from + fade_range fades its ring out, gone at fade_from (the thin line would break into dots)

edge._note: the circle is drawn as clipped rows, thin where its edge is steep: max_step is the largest step of its edge in px, max_row the tallest row
